facts.value: A digital language certificate indicating your language level according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) is awarded for each passed exam.
The certificate is recognized by the International Office and Global Office of Goethe University.
The certificate is issued in bilingual format (German and English).
This language certificate can be used for your applications abroad or later in your job search.
You can find out your grades only after receiving your certificate via email, approximately 4 to 5 weeks after the exam date.
For elective module courses and Master's courses, grades can be viewed password-protected in QIS.
